svg.text: ATtiny85 Digital Dice Simulator — Standalone Circuit Schematic

g.text: D (pin 6) → GND (values 1–6 need only 3 bits). /LT and /BI → +5V (lamp test & blanking off). LE → GND (latch transparent).
PB4 (pin 3) is left unconnected and read as ADC2 to seed the random generator. Dashed parts (R8) are optional. Place C1 and C2 right next to their IC power pins.
Use 220Ω–330Ω resistors for R1–R7. Display pin numbers shown are for a 5161AS (common cathode) — verify against your display's datasheet. Dots = connections.
